elements.requirement: The Criminal Damage Act 1971 comes into force at the expiration of the period of three months beginning with the day in which it is passed.
elements.quote: shall come into force at the expiration of the period of three months beginning with the day in which it is passed

elements.requirement: The Act may be cited as the Criminal Damage Act 1971.
elements.quote: may be cited as the Criminal Damage Act 1971

elements.requirement: Except as provided by subsections (4) to (6), the Act does not extend to Scotland or Northern Ireland.

elements.requirement: Part II of the Schedule to the Act and so much of section 11(8) as relates thereto extend to Scotland.

elements.requirement: Section 11(2) of the Act, Part III of the Schedule, and so much of section 11(8) as relates thereto extend to Scotland and Northern Ireland.
